title: A least-recently-used cache
description:
src/cache.py has an LRUCache class with put(key, value), get(key, default=None) and len().

The cache holds at most capacity entries. When a new key arrives and the cache is already full, the entry that was used least recently is the one thrown away.

Using an entry means touching it in any way that succeeds: a successful get counts as a use, and so does a put that replaces the value of a key already in the cache. Both make that key the most recently used one, so both change which key gets evicted next. A get for a key that is not present returns the default and counts as nothing.

The constructor must raise ValueError if capacity is zero or negative.

Some of the tests in tests/test_visible.py are failing. Find out why and fix src/cache.py.
